title: Real-World Outcomes of minimally invasive versus open surgery in early-stage ovarian and borderline tumors, ROMIO-trial
summary:
Diese multizentrische Datenbankstudie zielt darauf ab,
1. die Verbreitung und Anwendung minimalinvasiver chirurgischer Techniken bei frühem invasivem Eierstockskrebs und Borderline-Tumoren in universitären deutschen Zentren zu quantifizieren
2. Unterschiede in chirurgischen Strategien, perioperativen Ergebnissen und onkologischen Endpunkten zu identifizieren
3. praxisrelevante Daten zur Grundlage zukünftiger Leitlinien-Updates und Versorgungsoptimierungen bereitzustellen

interventions.name:
The planned study is designed as a retrospective observational study.
All patients who underwent surgery for early-stage ovarian cancer or borderline ovarian tumors between 2019 and 2023 at participating study centers will be retrospectively identified and analyzed. Clinical, surgical, pathological

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Early-stage malignant ovarian tumors (pT1–pT2, FIGO stage I–II, cM0)
Borderline ovarian tumors
Primary surgical treatment
Surgery performed between January 2019 and December 2023
Exclusion criteria:
Ovarian metastases from other primary tumors
Benign ovarian tumors
Tumors treated with neoadjuvant systemic therapy prior to surgery
